seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.

image_urls.title: Image URLs
image_urls.description: The reference images to edit or compose from (up to 10).

bounding_boxes.title: Bounding Boxes
bounding_boxes.description: Optional layout, with (0, 0) at the top-left of each image: keep, move, resize or remove objects from the references, or place new ones. Name boxes in the prompt by label, e.g. ``.

label.title: Label
label.description: Short name for the object in this box, e.g. `dragon`. Write `` in the prompt to tie the box to those words; a box the prompt doesn't name is added to the scene. Defaults to `obj_`.

source_box.description: Where the object is in the reference image. Requires `source_image_index`.

source_image_index.title: Source Image Index
source_image_index.description: 0-based index into `image_urls` of the reference the object comes from. Leave unset for a new object.

description.title: Description
description.description: What to draw in this box: the object and its look.
examples: a large fluffy knitted dragon in terracotta and mustard yarn

target_box.description: Where the object goes in the output image. Leave unset to remove a referenced object; set both boxes to move or resize it.

box.description: Where the object goes in the output image, as on text-to-image. Use instead of `source_box`/`target_box`.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image, 256 to 4096 pixels per side. If not set, a single reference image's own size (scaled to at most 4 megapixels) is used, or the first reference image's size (at most 1 megapixel) when several are given.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A complete caption of the target image with the edit folded in. Refer to the references by their order: the first image, the second image.

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: If set to true, the prompt is expanded into a detailed caption (grounded in the reference images when editing) before generation.

num_images.title: Number of Images
num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt used for generating the image.

timings.title: Timings
timings.description: The timings of the generation process.

has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts
has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed used to generate the first image.
